scope: Resident individuals and resident spouses filing jointly, calendar years from 2022: s 1102(a)(14); s 1103; s 1105; s 1106(b)(2), (b)(3)b.-f., (b)(4); ss 1107, 1108(a)(3), (b); s 1110(b), (c); s 1117(a)(2), (b); s 1161(1); s 1162(a)(1)-(3); s 1168. Federal AGI, taxable Social Security, federal exemptions and the federal EIC are inputs; the other s 1106 modifications and itemized deductions are input totals. Out: nonresidents, part-year residents, earlier years, trusts, lump-sum tax, the Director's tables, other credits, withholding, penalties (30 Del. C. ch. 5, not deposited).
seat: the individual taxpayer resident in Delaware (alone or with a spouse on a joint return)
